artifacts.summary: Nine-phase plan for the countermodel half of BimodalLib: a PointTruth-generic CountermodelEntry type, both TRANSFER theorems, one kernel-checked entry per admitted grade, registration of the hand-built refutations, lookup up to atom renaming, index census, tests, and the docs/record reconciliation.

memory_candidates.content: In a Lean deploy-consumer repo, a plan phase's narrowing-selector output is NEVER the no-suite sentinel alone, even when every path the phase names maps to no shell suite. scripts/plan-file-scope-harvest.sh appends the repo's declared coupled generated surface (typst/generated/status.typ in BimodalLogic) to EVERY phase carrying a .lean edit, and that path maps to real suites (test-plan-file-scope-harvest.sh, test-validate-artifact.sh). validate-artifact.sh re-derives the selector over the HARVESTED set, not the authored list, so a sentinel-only Tier Justification is flagged as a false claim on every Lean phase. Author the justification against the harvested set: name the two real suites and omit the sentinel token entirely (the validator greps the whole justification block for it).
